notes: Tatyova: 'Whenever a land you control enters, you gain 1 life and draw a card.' The opponent's Forest entering must not trigger (no life, no draw for either player). Your Forest put onto the battlefield (not played) triggers once: +1 life, +1 card. Seat 0 hand: opening draw (1) + Forest (1) - Forest entered (1) + Tatyova draw (1) = 2. Seat 1 hand: Forest entered -> 0.
